Questions about O Du Liebe Meiner Liebe

What is the doh of O Du Liebe Meiner Liebe?

In this version, in G major, doh is G. If your choir sings it in another key, doh moves to the new key note and every solfa syllable stays the same — that is what movable doh means.

What note does O Du Liebe Meiner Liebe start on?

It starts on d (G in G major), a pickup before the first full bar. Find doh first, then sing up or down to d.

What words can be sung to O Du Liebe Meiner Liebe?

O Du Liebe Meiner Liebe is in the metre 8.7.8.7: lines of 8, 7, 8, 7 syllables. Words written in the same metre fit it, such as Jesus, Tender Shepherd, Hear Me; check where the stresses fall before you sing them together.

Is O Du Liebe Meiner Liebe in the public domain?

Yes. Johann Thommen's work dates from 1745; the tune was first published in 1745. Everyone named died before 1955 and it was published before 1929, so the tune is out of copyright in the UK, the EU, the United States and Nigeria. Modern arrangements of it can still be under copyright.
